mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM app_user WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT note_id, request_sha256 FROM ma_note_request WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND idempotency_key = #{key}

SELECT r.note_id, s.source_id, v.version, n.title, v.body_markdown, v.status AS index_status, v.created_at AS updated_at, s.status AS source_status FROM ma_note_request r JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id = r.source_id AND s.account_id = r.account_id JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = s.source_id AND v.version = s.current_version JOIN ma_note_version n ON n.source_id = v.source_id AND n.version = v.version WHERE r.account_id = #{accountId} AND r.note_id = #{noteId} AND s.type = 'NOTE'

SELECT s.source_id,s.type,s.origin_id,s.status,s.created_at,s.current_version, v.status AS index_status,v.answer_state FROM ma_source s JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id = s.source_id AND v.version = s.current_version WHERE s.account_id = #{accountId} AND s.source_id = #{sourceId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT c.notebook_id,c.question_id::text AS question_id,c.revision,c.result_id,c.turn_id,c.request_id, c.source_id,c.source_version,c.version_hash, CASE WHEN (c.result_id IS NOT NULL AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND v.status <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND v.purged_at IS NULL AND v.body_markdown IS NOT NULL) OR (c.turn_id IS NOT NULL AND t.status='SUCCEEDED' AND encode(sha256(convert_to(t.answer_markdown,'UTF8')),'hex')=c.version_hash) THEN c.excerpt_text END AS excerpt_text, ((c.result_id IS NULL AND c.turn_id IS NULL) OR (c.result_id IS NOT NULL AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND v.status <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND v.purged_at IS NULL AND v.body_markdown IS NOT NULL) OR (c.turn_id IS NOT NULL AND t.status='SUCCEEDED' AND encode(sha256(convert_to(t.answer_markdown,'UTF8')),'hex')=c.version_hash)) AS available FROM ma_note_context c LEFT JOIN ma_source s ON s.source_id=c.source_id AND s.account_id=c.account_id LEFT JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id=c.source_id AND v.version=c.source_version LEFT JOIN tutor_turn t ON t.account_id=c.account_id AND t.turn_id=c.turn_id WHERE c.account_id=#{accountId} AND c.note_id=#{noteId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND question_id=CAST(#{questionId} AS BIGINT))

SELECT req.request_id,s.source_id,v.version AS source_version,v.body_markdown FROM ma_result result JOIN ma_run run ON run.run_id=result.run_id JOIN ma_request req ON req.account_id=run.account_id AND req.request_id=run.request_id JOIN ma_source s ON s.account_id=req.account_id AND s.type='TUTOR_REPLY' AND s.origin_id=result.result_id JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id=s.source_id AND v.version=s.current_version WHERE req.account_id=#{accountId} AND req.question_id=CAST(#{questionId} AS BIGINT) AND result.result_id=#{resultId} AND result.status='VERIFIED' AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND v.purged_at IS NULL AND v.status <> 'WITHDRAWN'

SELECT request_id,NULL::text AS source_id,NULL::bigint AS source_version,answer_markdown AS body_markdown FROM tutor_turn WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND question_id=CAST(#{questionId} AS BIGINT) AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND status='SUCCEEDED'
SELECT notebook_id,name,revision,updated_at FROM ma_notebook WHERE account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC,notebook_id DESC
SELECT notebook_id,name,revision,updated_at FROM ma_notebook WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND notebook_id=#{notebookId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ma_notebook SET name=#{name},revision=revision+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND notebook_id=#{notebookId}
UPDATE ma_note_context SET notebook_id=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND notebook_id=#{notebookId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ma_notebook WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND notebook_id=#{notebookId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ma_note_context SET notebook_id=#{notebookId},revision=revision+1 WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND note_id=#{noteId}
mapper.select:
SELECT s.origin_id AS note_id,s.source_id,v.version,n.title,v.body_markdown, v.status AS index_status,v.created_at AS updated_at,s.status AS source_status FROM ma_source s JOIN ma_source_version v ON v.source_id=s.source_id AND v.version=s.current_version JOIN ma_note_version n ON n.source_id=v.source_id AND n.version=v.version LEFT JOIN ma_note_context c ON c.account_id=s.account_id AND c.note_id=s.origin_id WHERE s.account_id=#{accountId} AND s.type='NOTE' AND s.status='ACTIVE'
AND (n.title ILIKE #{query} ESCAPE '!' OR v.body_markdown ILIKE #{query} ESCAPE '!')
AND c.notebook_id=#{notebookId} AND c.notebook_id IS NULL AND c.question_id=CAST(#{questionId} AS BIGINT)
AND (v.created_at,s.origin_id) < (#{beforeTime},#{beforeId})
ORDER BY v.created_at DESC,s.origin_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
